Assessment summary from a SAM fit

Source: R/hr_assessment.R
hr_assessment_from_fit.Rd

Builds the current assessment's rows of the assessment history (the format of hr_assessment_template) from a SAM fit, so the history doesn't depend on ICES SAG. Recruitment, SSB and F (Fbar) come from the fit, the reference biomass and harvest rate from SAMutils::rby.sam() if ref_bio_type is given. F and the harvest rate are left empty in the assessment year (no catch data), as are landings.

Usage

hr_assessment_from_fit(
  sam_fit,
  input_data_landings,
  species,
  assessment_year,
  ref_bio_type = NULL
)

Arguments

sam_fit

A SAM fit (sam_fit$fit from SAMutils::full_sam_fit()).

input_data_landings

Landings by year with columns year and catch (kg), e.g. from hr_input_data_landings.

species

Species code.

assessment_year

Assessment year.

ref_bio_type

NULL (no reference biomass, e.g. for F-based advice), "length" or "age" (passed to SAMutils::rby.sam()). Default NULL.

Value

A tibble with the columns of hr_assessment_template, landings in tonnes.
